subject: Helion Health — private deploy architecture deep-dive (VPC / air-gapped)
body:
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@helionhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: devops@helionhealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment deep-dive: VPC + air-gapped requirements

Jonas — thanks again for the quick demo last week. Helion is moving toward a pilot that requires a VPC-hosted control plane with an air-gapped on-prem inference enclave. Before we engage procurement we need a technical deep-dive to align on network topology, expected operational touchpoints, and data flow (particularly logs and key management).

Are you available for a 60–90 minute session next week? Our timeline is tight — target start of pilot is 2027-04-01. I attached a short list of questions and a rough diagram we sketched out.

Attachments: helion-private-deploy-questions.pdf (pdf), candidate-network-diagram.png (png)

—Sarah
Sarah Lewis
Senior IT Architect, Helion Health

---
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@helionhealth.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment deep-dive: VPC + air-gapped requirements

Hi Sarah — thanks for the context and the attachments. We can definitely run a focused architecture review covering: control plane networking, self-hosted vs managed pieces, KMS/HSM options, audit/log forwarding, and our air-gap checklist (shipping, images, and offline upgrades).

Proposed slots (60–90m):
- Tue 2027-03-16, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 2027-03-17, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 2027-03-18, 09:00–10:30 PT

If none of those work, share a few times that suit Helion and we’ll adjust. I’ve uploaded our private deploy checklist and a sample network diagram to the shared Drive link below for pre-read.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3Helion-architecture
Calendly (my availability): https://calendly.com/jonas-weber/30min

Thanks — I’ll also loop in Tessa (engineering lead for private) and Vanessa (solutions engineer) so we have the right folks for KMS and air-gap operational runbook questions.

—Jonas Weber
Solutions Lead, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

---
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment deep-dive: VPC + air-gapped requirements

Quick internal note — Jonas, I can take the KMS/HSM and audit logs portion. Vanessa, can you cover image signing and the airgap deliverables (bootstrap, offline packages, validation)? I’ll prepare the network segmentation slides and an example iptables/VPC route table mapping for Helion’s use case.

I also recommend we ask Helion for:
- existing on-prem NAC/segmentation docs
- their preferred KMS vendor (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, on-prem HSM)
- expected retention window for logs (30/90/365 days)

I’ll draft a 1-page pre-read tonight.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Engineering Manager, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference

---
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@helionhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: devops@helionhealth.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment deep-dive: VPC + air-gapped requirements

Thanks — the Wed 3/17 slot at 13:00 PT works best for our core team. We have two additional DevOps folks who would like to join; forwarding to devops@helionhealth.com.

We’ll bring: network diagrams (internal), our current KMS vendor, and a list of compliance controls (SOC2 + HIPAA specifics). Can you share the pre-read once available?

—Sarah

---
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@helionhealth.com>, devops@helionhealth.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment deep-dive: VPC + air-gapped requirements (confirmed)

Great — Wed 2027-03-17 13:00–14:30 PT confirmed. I created a calendar invite and attached the 1-page pre-read and an example runbook skeleton. Please review the pre-read before the meeting; it calls out a few items I’d like to validate with your team (image signing process, outbound telemetry aggregation, and emergency patch workflow).

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood-private-deploy-pre-read.pdf (pdf)
- airgap-runbook-skeleton.docx (docx)

Calendar: invite sent to all participants.

Agenda (high level):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) Control plane & VPC network design (20m)
3) On-prem air-gapped enclave: bootstrapping, images, upgrades (25m)
4) KMS/HSM, keys-in-use and key-rotation (15m)
5) Next steps / mutual action plan (10m)

If anything changes on Helion’s side, reply-all with alternate times and we’ll find a new slot. Looking forward to it.

—Jonas
Solutions Lead, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference
